0022600183.text: Phoenix (1-3, 1-1 at home, on a two-game losing streak) hosts Portland (5-1, 4-0 on the road, on a two-game winning streak) in the Suns' sixth game of the season, with the Suns sitting 12th in the West and 2.5 games back in the Pacific while the Trail Blazers are 1st in the Northwest. Portland won the only meeting so far this season, 124-83 in Portland on October 21, after Phoenix won the 2025-26 series 2-1. Mark Williams is out for Phoenix following shoulder surgery, and Jordan Goodwin is day-to-day with a calf injury and is a game-time decision, while Portland is missing Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), both out.
